additional_info.subject: ID0390117-DC/Si-D/FI-[twlhzB] - Imatra Skoda Enyaq RS 2024 short charging sessions CRM:00315002060
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
As we already aligned via Teams, I will show the information that I gathered regarding this Skoda Enyaq:
It seems that the EV sends a strange information to us regarding the RemainingTimeToFullSoC:
The first message is before the ParameterDiscovery phase so there is no value, and we get the 4500 (sec) during ParameterDiscovery, during charging we get another value 4200 and after 3mins we receive a 0 value. When we receive this value is when the charging starts to stop and ramp down.
At the end of the session we see that there is no problem with SECC or charger as there is no error reported.
The only thing that I believe that can be the issue since the sessions are 5-6mins, is that there is a Timeout for some kind of misbehavior like the fact that the TarVol - NowVol = ~50V.
I can only theorize here since we don't have access to that kind of information.
From our side, I believe there is nothing we can do as this seems to be this specific EV issue.
Let me know if this is enough information and if I can close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
